assessments.statement: solver.terminal_horizon_truncation: Expected observation met in direction: the newly read plans view returns effective_horizon below the configured 10 intervals for the late run-up/settling updates (26->9, 27->8, 28->7, 29->6; 24 is exactly 10), so the horizon is truncated in the settling run-up and the condition is retained. Qualification: at the sampled updates the value equals the 0.01 s control intervals remaining to the 0.35 s task end, so this is terminal horizon clipping rather than a demonstrated budget pathology. This is plan-level effective_horizon evidence, not backend motion, and does not by itself tie the truncation to the sampled holding violation.

controller.budget_truncated_plan_selection: Expected observation met for the stop status: all eight sampled updates stop by optimization_raw_status = User_Requested_Stop with policy_stop_reason = budget_best_feasible (updates 24,26,31,32,33) and plan_accepted = true, so plan selection is budget-limited and the hypothesis is retained. Detail correction: the expected optimization_selected_iteration = 0 holds only at updates 24,27,28 (F690, F693, F701) and not at the later updates, whose selected iteration rises to 94 at update 33 (F671), so budget truncation is confirmed while the 'zero-iteration at every update' pattern is not uniform. No causal attribution is drawn.

assessments.statement: tendon_force_limit_saturation_driving_hold_speed: The intended weakening did not occur cleanly: updates 24-28 and 33 keep applied tensions well below the 8.0 N per-tendon limit (update 24 max 4.756 N, F719), but update 31 actual_input_n channel 0 = 7.999886883378158 N (F702) and update 32 requested_input_n channel 0 = 7.999987676698501 N (F724), both within ~1.1e-4 N of the 8 N bound, i.e. effectively at saturation in the settling run-up. force_bound_violation_n stays 0.0 in both runs, and these are commanded plan-level tensions, not measured backend forces, so the mixed pattern neither supports nor refutes force-limit saturation as the driver of the sampled hold speed; the hypothesis is left unresolved.

check.authorization: Current frozen diagnosis request; no production change or backend execution.
expected_observations: For the queried late run-up and settling-window updates the archived plans view returns effective_horizon below the configured 10 intervals (e.g., 5), continuing the update-30 truncation.
For the queried updates the archived plans view returns optimization_raw_status = User_Requested_Stop with optimization_selected_iteration = 0.
For the queried updates actual_tension_n remains a clear margin below the 8.0 N per-tendon limit rather than pinned at saturation.
check.proceed_if: It separates plan-level truncation (truncated effective_horizon plus User_Requested_Stop budget stops) from actuator/force saturation (tensions pinned near 8 N): truncated horizons and budget stops with sub-limit tensions would retain solver.terminal_horizon_truncation and controller.budget_truncated_plan_selection while weakening tendon_force_limit_saturation_driving_hold_speed; full 10-interval horizons or near-limit tensions would reverse those two effects. The retained scalar comparisons alone cannot separate these mechanisms, since terminal reach passes while both holding limits fail.
check.proposal: For a spread of controller updates not yet displayed (the settling window and its run-up), does the archived plans view show per-update effective_horizon truncated below the configured 10 intervals together with budget-driven optimization stops, rather than per-tendon tensions pinned near the 8 N limit, so as to distinguish plan-truncation explanations from a tendon force-saturation explanation of the sampled holding-window position/speed violation?
check.revise_if: Interpret the received result against the declared outcomes.
check.stop_if: Stop after the single plans-view batch returns effective_horizon, optimization_raw_status, optimization_selected_iteration and actual_tension_n for the selected update_ids.; Conclude if the returned horizon, stop reason, selected iteration and applied tensions do not co-vary with the recorded settling-window violation.; Do not exceed one read or 180 s wall; do not extend to unlisted update_ids or to numerical solves in this check.
weakening_observations: For the queried updates actual_tension_n remains a clear margin below the 8.0 N per-tendon limit rather than pinned at saturation.

policy.computation: Reported separately; never substitutes for reach or holding acceptance.
policy.objective: Raw scalar objectives under different weights are not ranked.
policy.rule: Joint acceptance first; otherwise componentwise physical comparison.
policy.tradeoff: Any physical improvement accompanied by physical worsening is a trade-off, not overall improvement.

coverage.definition: Both endpoints, timestamps aligned to task sample_period_s; missing samples are unavailable, never a pass.

duration.definition: Final closed interval [task duration - window, task duration].

position.definition: Maximum sampled world tip position error in the final interval.

speed.definition: Maximum sampled world tip translational speed norm in the final interval.
Euclidean norm of tip-site translational Jacobian times recorded backend qvel, reconstructed with sealed robot.xml and qpos; no finite differencing

terminal.definition: Euclidean world tip position error at the final execution sample; sealed evaluate.reach is the outcome authority.

control_period.definition: Simulated control spacing; synchronous wall overruns do not imply skipped applied updates or injected actuator delay.

duration.definition: Simulated task horizon, separate from computation wall time.

timing.interpretation: Applied updates, initialization selections, simulated duration and measured wall time are separate facts.

spendable.reservations: Running/unknown calls are charged at reservation until sealed; included once in ledger usage.

unmet_criterion: Historical joint reach/holding acceptance is false; exact criteria are host-bound.
